full_prompt_en: A square hand-painted anime illustration shows a white-haired traveler crouching beside a squat, weathered armored figure against an old teal wall. The background is made of large horizontal masonry courses, their uneven joints and chipped edges rendered in dark blue-gray and ochre. The lower wall shifts to dusty tan near the ground, where small stones lie scattered across the orange-brown foreground. At left, the slim traveler crouches low with the head bowed toward the armored companion. White hair is tied into a short trailing section, and a long rust-red coat drapes over bent purple trousers and dark wrapped boots. One pale hand appears near the knees; the face is partly hidden by hair and the downward angle. At right, the compact armored figure sits directly on the ground. Its round helmet-like head has a narrow dark slit and small dark marks; thick rounded shoulders, forearms, and feet are built from worn beige metal. Dark seams and mottled scratches make the armor look heavy and used. A long red-handled sword rises diagonally behind it, with the hilt visible over the right shoulder. The two forms sit close together in the middle of the empty wall, with their shared low height giving the moment a quiet, vulnerable character. Fine ink contours are softened by grainy painted color and dusty surface wear. Diffuse daylight comes from the upper left, touching the pale hair, armor tops, and stones while leaving the wall joints and recesses darker. The overall composition is sparse and affectionate, using a broad weathered backdrop and modest warm-cool color contrast to focus on the still encounter.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形手绘动漫插画呈现一名白发旅人，蹲在矮壮、风化的装甲形体旁，背后是一堵古旧青绿色墙。背景由大块水平砌石层组成，不齐接缝和崩缺边缘用深蓝灰与赭色绘出。墙下段靠地处转为灰土黄，橙棕色前景上散着小石块。左侧，纤细旅人低身蹲着，垂头面向装甲伙伴。白发扎成短短后垂一束，长铁锈红外衣落在屈起的紫色裤腿和深色缠带靴子上。一只浅色手出现在膝旁；脸被头发与低垂角度部分挡住。右侧，紧凑装甲形体直接坐在地上。圆头盔般的头部有一条狭窄深色缝和几个小深印；厚实圆肩、前臂与双脚由磨旧米色金属组成。深接缝与斑驳刮痕让装甲显得沉重、久经使用。长红柄剑在其身后斜向升起，刀柄露在右肩上方。两个形体贴近坐在空旷墙体的中央，靠近地面的共同高度令这一刻安静而脆弱。细墨轮廓被颗粒绘画颜色与蒙尘表面磨损柔化。漫射日光从左上方照来，触及浅发、装甲上面与石块，墙缝和凹处则较暗。整体构图稀疏而温情，以宽阔风化背景与适度冷暖色对照，把注意力集中在静止的相遇上。
style_prompt_en: The hand-painted anime style balances precise but unobtrusive ink contours with grainy, muted color and worn surfaces. Cool teal and blue-gray planes dominate, interrupted by a few rust-red and dusty orange accents; pale cream highlights bring the focal volumes forward. Rounded heavy forms contrast with slimmer angular forms, giving the arrangement a quiet dialogue of scale and weight. Broad horizontal joints and a low foreground band create stable geometry, while small scattered marks keep the ground tactile. Edge quality is softened by stipple, chips, and pigment variation rather than polished gradients. Diffuse daylight lifts upper planes gently and leaves shallow recesses darker, with no theatrical spotlight. Generous empty space around the compact center makes the image feel paused and contemplative. The overall effect is warm despite its weathered palette, using material wear and restrained color to make simple shapes emotionally resonant.
style_prompt_zh: 这种手绘动漫风格让精确却不抢眼的墨线轮廓与颗粒、低调色彩及磨损表面取得平衡。冷青绿和蓝灰平面占主导，被少量铁锈红与灰橙色重音打断；浅奶油色高光把焦点体积带向前。圆润沉重形体对照更纤细棱角的形体，让排列产生安静的尺度与重量对话。宽阔水平接缝和低矮前景带建立稳定几何，小而散的笔迹则让底部可触。边缘靠点纹、缺口和颜料变化柔化，而非抛光渐层。漫射日光轻提上方面，让浅凹处较暗，没有戏剧性聚光。紧凑中心周围的宽裕空白让画面像停顿下来的思考。整体效果虽有风化色板却温暖，借材料磨损与克制颜色使简单形状带有情感回响。
theme_en: A crouching white-haired traveler beside a squat weathered armored figure
theme_zh: 白发旅人蹲在矮壮风化的装甲形体旁
name: Hiromu Arakawa
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
